feedback: Reed's confession follows the pre-vote chain well: the crossed-out sentence, possession of a poison sample, and visit to the waiting glass were all available. The new explicit admission of dosing confirms the accusation rather than supplying a missing mechanism. His attempt to control the public version connects the scholarly grievance to his method, and the final line about Claire gives it an emotional consequence. Chip and Elle resolve their lies into different nonmurder offenses, which makes their suspicion feel purposeful. The ending is earned, although Reed's sample admission in the final round still bears much of the identification burden; an earlier subtle trace would make the solution feel less dependent on his last voluntary statement.
